entities.summary: Emil Todorov Chuprenski was boxer from Bulgaria who competed for his native country at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul, South Korea. There he was defeated in the quarterfinals of the Men's Lightweight Division by USA's eventual bronze medalist Romallis Ellis. He was born in Sofia.
